subject: Propellr console walkthrough + API enablement — scheduling and day-of plan

From: Sana Malik <sana@propellr.io>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Propellr onboarding: console walkthrough + API enablement

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. The Propellr product team is ready to do a hands-on console walkthrough and then a short API enablement lab so our engineers can validate the integration with our staging environment.

Attendees: myself (PM), Rakesh Patel (Eng manager), Lina Gomez (SRE), and our CPO may join.

Preferred windows next week (PDT):
- Tue Jul 21, 10:00–12:00
- Wed Jul 22, 14:00–16:00 (preferred)

We want to cover: console onboarding (20m), model routing & cost controls (20m), API keys + service account setup (15m), and a short live lab (45m). If needed we can split into two 60-minute blocks.

Can you confirm which slots work and if there are any prerequisites for the lab (service account, test data, ports)? Also please share any pre-read or checklist we should complete.

Thanks —
Sana
Sana Malik
Product Lead, Propellr
Sana: 415-555-0198

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Propellr onboarding: console walkthrough + API enablement

Hi Sana —

Thanks — Wed Jul 22 14:00–16:00 PDT works for our team. I'll run the console portion and loop in Dev for the API lab. Quick checklist and prerequisites attached (propellr-onboard-checklist.pdf). Key items to complete before the session:
- Create a staging service account and add jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com as a viewer
- Generate a test API key (scoped to staging)
- Provision a small test corpus (100–300 documents) for embedding/reranking checks

Proposed agenda (120m):
1) 14:00–14:25 — Console walkthrough + RBAC & routing
2) 14:25–14:45 — Cost controls & batching best practices
3) 14:45–15:00 — Short break / Qs
4) 15:00–15:45 — API enablement lab (Dev leads)
5) 15:45–16:00 — Next steps & action items

If you prefer two 60m sessions, we can split Console + Controls in session A and API lab in session B. Let me know.

I attached the checklist for your infra team and will send a calendar invite once we lock the final format.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: propellr-onboard-checklist.pdf
